title: X (Twitter) Engagement Protocol SOP
content:
Standard X (Twitter) Engagement Protocol — five rules:

1. POSITIVE MENTION, HIGH-REACH (account with 1000+ followers): Reply publicly using replyToTweet with text: 'Thanks @[username]! [short acknowledgment]. #CorpX'. Must include the #CorpX hashtag.

2. POSITIVE MENTION, LOW-REACH (account with fewer than 1000 followers): Like the tweet only using the 'like' action. Do NOT reply publicly to low-reach accounts.

3. NEGATIVE MENTION (complaint, criticism, or negative sentiment about the company): Send a DM via sendDM to the user with text starting: 'Hi @[username], sorry to hear this. [support message]'. NEVER reply publicly to a negative mention.

4. VERIFIED EXPERT relevant post (post from a verified expert account discussing a topic relevant to company products): Quote-tweet using quoteTweet with a company perspective or relevant insight.

5. COMPETITOR-TAGGED post (post that mentions or tags a competitor alongside the company): Ignore entirely — do NOT like, reply, retweet, or DM.

Follower thresholds are based on the followers count in the user profile. Check user profile before deciding action type.
